mentions.name: epc
mentions.description: This project is an embedded software parameter DSL and compiler. It lets firmware developers define configuration values, thresholds, constants, and other application-level parameters in a structured, human-readable format, and compiles them into binary data that the firmware can directly use.
mentions.source_excerpt: Also, 2 months ago, I did a weekend challenge to build an embedded software parameter DSL and compiler. Its goal is to let firmware developers define configuration values, thresholds, constants, and other application-level parameters in a structured, human-readable format, and compile them into binary data that the firmware can directly use. https://github.com/raphui/epc
